scope: All fourteen originally proven frozen pilot witnesses only. Exact original starts, source walks and query constraints are preserved; no named-start substitution or solver invocation. Source nodes/segments reconstructed uniquely from pinned OSM extracts; source shapes checked against current complete compiled profiles. Numerical, access, road and start eligibility are separate. A witness excluded here does not certify no other real or compiled route exists.

startComparison.comparison: Stable source ID, every start field except snapshot-local node index, full 3D coordinate, and owner cell. All read gzip byte sizes, JSON byte sizes and SHA-256 verified against each immutable manifest. Snapshot-local numeric indices may legitimately renumber.

littleSiHttpRecovery.objective: Seek original start and exact ordered or reversed fixed walk for up to120s. Similar representatives are recorded only after search ends or the observation window expires, never used to stop exact recovery early.
littleSiHttpRecovery.scope: Fresh actual HTTP app and worker; no live application contacted. Original frozen query plus explicit1mi/10%roads. Observes retained WorkerEvent sections, independently compares against source-proven fixed walk, then confirms HTTP page, independently reconstructed snapshot geometry and GPX. A similar representative is not exact witness recovery. RSS includes app, worker, HTTP client and independent verifier; browser excluded. Concurrent work/caches uncontrolled; descriptive timing only.

beforeStop.selectionNote: Similar routes are grouped across all starting places. Routes sharing at least 85% of both their overall path and their loop share one representative; this does not stop exploration. Substantially different loops or approaches remain separate, without a result-count limit.
